purpose: Shared product imagery for the Chinese and English company website

maintenance.selection: Choose the matching visual id for the device or use. Add or revise the registry entry instead of adding a page-specific image URL.
maintenance.identity: Keep self-developed designs, original-manufacturer options, software screenshots and lifestyle scenes distinct.
maintenance.panels: OEM bedside, entrance and curtain panels share one source image. Preserve each complete portrait panel inside the page frame; do not zoom or vertically crop the device.
maintenance.retirement: Old device imagery remains in repository history or unused public files. It is not an active product source.

appearance.palette: Cold white, pale silver and a restrained ice-blue status point
appearance.mark: Small same-material shallow recessed graphic emblem; no company wordmark on the enclosure
appearance.forms: Host, water-contact pebble, acoustic bar and flat mmWave disc retain different functional forms
appearance.interfaces: Show interfaces required by the device. Do not add USB, Ethernet or HDMI to a wireless sensing enclosure for decoration.

scope.server_deployment: Performed by the website owner after GitHub upload
